selection: Immutable root-selected approved/developed oncology ADC-antigen family, external clinical development rationale. No added genes or outcome-dependent threshold/group selection.
question: Is there a previously unreported reproducible native-EMC RNA phenotype in this clinically fixed ADC-antigen family that would justify a specific localization/assay experiment, beyond existing gene allocation and clinical-target analyses?
stage: Source/prior-art/value gate only; no gene values, matrices, ranking, new statistics or numerical stage until root review.
known_exposures: Prior R8 approved-target values and original atlas targets were already exposed. All seven genes have prior evaluative exposure: first four in R8 FDA6 panel, CD276 in original atlas12, GPNMB/LRRC15 in broad surface discovery. Current safe projection reads names and prior allocation Boolean only; no new gene outcome cells.
precise_reuse_boundary: GPNMB/LRRC15 allocated=False belongs to older broad membrane-screen allocation, not necessarily complete relevant source evaluation or an exact seven-antigen biological/value failure. The current family is not cold target discovery and may not relabel/recompute old failed questions.
safe_source_fields: TSV headers, exact gene symbol and prior allocated Boolean only
Clinical primary citation/title/drug/target aliases and trial type
No source gene/effect/p-value/rank fields or legacy genomic-row contents
primary_clinical_rationale_scope: Reuse R8 official FDA target/drug bindings for first4. Verify real human clinical ADC development source for CD276 (ifinatamab deruxtecan/B7-H3), GPNMB (glembatumumab vedotin/CDX-011) and LRRC15 (ABBV-085) via existing sources or at most three focused official primary-citation metadata requests. Cache originals, export only evaluated primary identities/target eligibility; no abstract endpoint-number projection.
expected_new_input: Clinical provenance alone does not create new RNA evidence. An actual unassessed native assay/source or a concretely distinct useful contrast must be identified before an explicit prospective follow-up proposal.
coverage: All13 nativeHofvander conditions, all6GSE24369/all10GSE4303/all4GSE28866 plus all relevant other public native tissue/molecular-label/assay conditions retained; source assay units and missing mapping not pooled or treated as zero. Cultures are context, not substitute native specimens.
potential_practical_use: A demonstrably new RNA association could guide a defined tissue localization experiment distinguishing tumor-cell signal from stroma/admixture and source-matched malignant/normal context. RNA does not establish surface protein, accessibility, dependency, efficacy or therapeutic window.
strongest_alternatives: Same prior allocation or source result restated with clinical drug names
Stromal/myxoid tissue admixture or normal tissue expression
Single favorable gene/case or reused donor
Published antigen prior art consumes proposed novelty
defeat_no_go: No meaningful unanswered contrast or new informative input beyond prior evaluations
Prior results re-ranked or thresholds changed to select favorable targets
Suitable public source conditions still unassessed
Bulk expression interpreted as tumor protein or efficacy
restrictions: No denied FAP-tissue/glycan/HLA/structural/fusion-formation content or added panel gene; ordinary antigens permitted. Quiet APIs/files only, no UI/login/private/access bypass/spend/outreach/publication/PR. <=8MiB new ignored originals, >=10GiB free, owned subtree only, root alone shared mutations/push, Codex author and committer.
